description:
List the mentorship plans (ongoing subscriptions) and one-off sessions a mentor offers. Use this after get_mentor_profile when the user is comparing what they'd get for the money.

TWO DIFFERENT BOOKING ROUTES — pay attention to `booking_route` on each item:
  - `subscriptions[]` (ongoing mentorship): book via the apply flow. Each subscription item already includes its `booking_url`. You can also pass its `hash` to create_booking_link(plan_hash=...).
  - `one_off_sessions[]`: book directly on the session page. Each item includes its `booking_url` — share THAT URL with the user, do NOT route a one-off session through create_booking_link.

Top-level `requires_intro_call` flags whether this mentor offers an intro call before signup (free or paid). When true, all subscription booking_urls route the user to the scheduler first. Read `intro_call_note` for whether it is free or paid, and mention that to the user when you share the link.
name: get_sessions_or_services

booking_url.description: Deep link to start this subscription (the /apply/ route).
booking_url.title: Booking Url

call_length_min.description: Length of each call in minutes.
call_length_min.title: Call Length Min

hands_on.description: Whether the plan includes hands-on help.
hands_on.title: Hands On

quarterly_available.description: Whether a quarterly billing option exists.
quarterly_available.title: Quarterly Available

response_time_hours.description: Expected response time in hours; may be fractional.
response_time_hours.title: Response Time Hours

tasks.description: Whether the plan includes task/assignment support.
tasks.title: Tasks

booking_url.description: Direct booking URL (the /sessions/ route). Share this URL directly; do NOT route through create_booking_link.
booking_url.title: Booking Url

error.description: Error code: 'not_found' or 'rate_limit_exceeded'. Absent on success.
error.title: Error

intro_call_note.description: Guidance about the intro call (free or paid); null when the mentor offers none.
intro_call_note.title: Intro Call Note

requires_intro_call.description: When true, every subscription booking_url routes to the scheduler first; mention the intro call (see intro_call_note for free vs paid).
requires_intro_call.title: Requires Intro Call
